item.text: {"chapter_id":"5B","issues":[{"question_id":"5B.1","issue_type":"period_error","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0014-E004","BATCH-0001-E011","BATCH-0016-E013"],"explanation":"The answer relies materially on pre-2023 enrollment effects and the 2022 oil auction while presenting them as part of the 2023 record. These are relevant context but cannot establish 2023 execution or sustainability."},{"question_id":"5B.1","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0020-E012","BATCH-0023-E001"],"explanation":"The answer describes free-primary-education implementation and PDL-145T construction as favorable implementation, but the cited evidence is mainly presidential or government reporting and does not independently verify quality, completion, or broad welfare effects."},{"question_id":"5B.2","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0014-E002","BATCH-0023-E020"],"explanation":"Competitive utility and road-fund appointments and an independent central-bank rate decision do not establish that Tshisekedi selected qualified professionals through credible personal processes or empowered them based on performance."},{"question_id":"5B.2","issue_type":"irrelevant_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0015-E006","BATCH-0019-E006"],"explanation":"Judicial appointments and removals are not direct evidence about economic personnel and add little to the specific economic-leadership lens."},{"question_id":"5B.3","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0029-E003","BATCH-0029-E005","BATCH-0015-E009","BATCH-0015-E010"],"explanation":"The answer gives substantial affirmative weight to formal fiscal, debt, royalty, and audit rules even though the cited material expressly establishes rules rather than compliance, operation, or outcomes."},{"question_id":"5B.3","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0024-E002","BATCH-0024-E003","BATCH-0024-E004","BATCH-0011-E013"],"explanation":"The answer omits the complete candidate-index evidence of 2023 account execution, parliamentary criticism of noncompliance, uncertified debts and unobserved works, and ineffective anti-corruption controls, all directly relevant to fiscal-rule administration."},{"question_id":"5B.4","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0014-E002","BATCH-0015-E008","BATCH-0015-E009"],"explanation":"Listing telecom, real-estate, special-economic-zone, and mining instruments does not show that rules were fair, consistently enforced, or protective of ordinary entrepreneurs, property holders, workers, or investors."},{"question_id":"5B.4","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0011-E015","BATCH-0023-E017","BATCH-0023-E018","BATCH-0010-E018"],"explanation":"The answer omits evidence of generally ineffective labor enforcement, serious labor-inspection weaknesses, and continuing abusive mining-property practices, which are central to fair economic rules."},{"question_id":"5B.5","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0019-E003","BATCH-0019-E004","BATCH-0021-E008","BATCH-0029-E007"],"explanation":"CENAREF inauguration, presidential anti-corruption rhetoric, a workshop, and formal transparency arrangements are treated as substantive anti-capture measures without evidence of enforcement, sanctions, recovery, or institutional independence."},{"question_id":"5B.5","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0011-E013","BATCH-0028-E001","BATCH-0029-E007","BATCH-0029-E008"],"explanation":"The answer should explicitly incorporate the 2023 finding that anti-corruption laws were ineffective, phantom payments and opaque accounts persisted, justice was slow for politically exposed persons, and beneficial-ownership disclosure remained incomplete."},{"question_id":"5B.6","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0023-E001","BATCH-0019-E009","BATCH-0014-E004"],"explanation":"The answer characterizes reported construction, free education, and partner projects as productive public investment, but the cited evidence does not establish completed, timely, high-quality, nationally distributed outputs attributable to the ruler."},{"question_id":"5B.6","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0017-E002","BATCH-0011-E015","BATCH-0022-E010","BATCH-0022-E013"],"explanation":"The answer omits the Social Fund dissolution and paused disbursements, ineffective enforcement and service shortages, millions out of school or displaced, and insufficient rural investment and infrastructure disruption."},{"question_id":"5B.7","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0020-E011","BATCH-0020-E012","BATCH-0023-E006","BATCH-0023-E003"],"explanation":"Presidential monitoring, an education review, and an announced telephone mechanism demonstrate monitoring structures or claims, not reliable public information, independent evaluation, or completed correction linked to evidence."},{"question_id":"5B.7","issue_type":"irrelevant_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0017-E003","BATCH-0013-E009"],"explanation":"CENI electoral-register audit transparency is largely unrelated to the economic evidence-and-correction question and distracts from fiscal, budgetary, and programme evaluation."},{"question_id":"5B.8","issue_type":"period_error","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0001-E017","BATCH-0014-E004"],"explanation":"The answer uses a 2022 poverty rate and 2021–2022 enrollment comparison as if they were 2023 incidence evidence. They are baseline or lagged context, not direct 2023 distributional outcomes."},{"question_id":"5B.8","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0008-E010","BATCH-0024-E006","BATCH-0026-E009"],"explanation":"Planned PDL-145T financing, carbon-credit allocation rules, and a planned gender-focused education project do not establish actual incidence across classes, regions, genders, or groups."},{"question_id":"5B.8","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0028-E020","BATCH-0011-E015","BATCH-0022-E005","BATCH-0020-E006"],"explanation":"The answer omits tenure-level currency and poverty deterioration, largely informal and weakly regulated employment, reported budget and teacher-pay claims without incidence evidence, and the absence of 2023 health-financing results."},{"question_id":"5B.9","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0021-E001","BATCH-0024-E005","BATCH-0007-E008"],"explanation":"Security coordination, exchange-rate directives, and announced price or monetary measures show intentions and institutional assignments, not necessarily funded, targeted, monitored, or effective shock responses."},{"question_id":"5B.9","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0022-E008","BATCH-0020-E010","BATCH-0022-E013","BATCH-0017-E002"],"explanation":"The answer understates the documented scale of fiscal and humanitarian response failure: high inflation, major aid shortfalls, disrupted agriculture and infrastructure, and paused social-program disbursements."},{"question_id":"5B.10","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0014-E002","BATCH-0014-E004","BATCH-0019-E009","BATCH-0025-E009"],"explanation":"The answer gives positive trajectory weight to reform claims, lagged enrollment, government-reported works, and a human-rights decline that is expressly not an economic outcome. These cannot demonstrate a stronger durable economic trajectory."},{"question_id":"5B.10","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0028-E020","BATCH-0016-E013","BATCH-0022-E008","BATCH-0020-E009"],"explanation":"The answer should include the candidate-index evidence of tenure-level currency depreciation, near-doubling acute food insecurity, persistent poverty, high inflation, and the World Bank's finding that growth was not translating into improved living conditions."},{"question_id":"5B.10","issue_type":"attribution_error","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0014-E002","BATCH-0014-E004","BATCH-0019-E009","BATCH-0011-E007"],"explanation":"The answer acknowledges partner and donor involvement but still aggregates World Bank-supported reforms, pre-2023 free-education effects, government-reported PDL-145T outputs, and Sicomines renegotiation as evidence of Tshisekedi's trajectory without sufficiently separating government, predecessor, partner, and ruler-specific attribution."}],"overall_assessment":"The ten answers generally acknowledge uncertainty, implementation gaps, external constraints, and attribution limits. However, the draft repeatedly gives affirmative weight to plans, official claims, formal rules, partner-funded programmes, and lagged or pre-period outcomes, while omitting several directly relevant contrary indicators on fiscal noncompliance, corruption, labor enforcement, service access, household welfare, and durable trajectory. The principal audit concern is evidentiary weighting and attribution rather than a single isolated factual error."}
